CheckTitle: Ensure Privileged and Administrative Roles Are Restricted to Known IP Addresses
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Description: With Location-Based Access Control enabled, privileged roles such as IT Security Manager and Application Implementation Consultant must not have 'Enable Role for Access from All IP Addresses' selected.
Risk: Privileged roles usable from any network can be abused from untrusted locations with stolen credentials.
AuditProcedure: Security Console > Roles > open each privileged role > Administration tab.
Confirm 'Enable Role for Access from All IP Addresses' is not selected.

Steps: Clear 'Enable Role for Access from All IP Addresses' on privileged roles.
Test access from a trusted and an untrusted IP.

DefaultValue: Not accessible from all IPs by default once LBAC is enabled.
